purpose: Present contextual information or a problem inside a page.
avoid: Do not assume every visible alert should interrupt assistive technology.
basis: Pinned React/primitive sources lead API, lifecycle and semantics; native visual observations and explicit reference decisions are mapped in figma/traceability.json.
profileRationale: Meaningful native content or a content container in its default source mode. Interactive descendants/native render overrides keep their own native or component contracts; no decorative fallback or invented selection API.
contentAlternative: The full problem and recovery instruction are text; the destructive color and optional icon are supplementary.
updatesAndDescendants: The actual wrapper renders role=alert. Use it for dynamically inserted urgent feedback; do not repeatedly replace identical content or force focus. Optional action buttons follow Button semantics.
referenceDecision: The concrete retry action and error wording are this reference composition; role=alert is in the pinned wrapper.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: Alert retains its four actual source wrappers and optional caller SVG. Native 8/10px padding, 8px icon/action gap, 2px title/description gap, 10px corner and 16px icon become semantic metrics; native 464px width/78px height remain examples. The reference uses intrinsic grid rows, shared 14/20px text and an explicit caller class when an icon is supplied. Actions move below text at a chosen 28rem narrow-view boundary. Actual variant classes select default/destructive roles; color supplements text. The pinned root always renders role=alert: caller policy reserves dynamic insertion for urgent changes and avoids duplicate announcements or forced focus. Retry is a caller Button, not a fabricated Alert event.
